websiteDescription:
• Packaged as one 32 Fluid Ounce (946 mL) bottle of Salt-Away Concentrate with Salt-Away’s unique Mixing Unit (Part Number: 260312-BLA) included. 
• Especially packaged with parts to accommodate international customers whose local plumbing threads are different from American water hose threads. 
• Included is ½ of a Quick Connector set (2 pieces) required to adapt the Salt-Away Mixing Unit to water hoses with threads different from American hose threads. The customer must supply the other ½ of a Quick Connector set made with threads that fit local water hoses to make the connection complete. 
• Recommended as the ‘Starter Kit’ for new customers of Salt-Away. 
• The Mixing Unit connects to a garden hose for dispensing. 
• No need to purchase Mixing Unit again. Refills of 32 fl oz (946 mL) or 128 fl oz (3.79 L) may be purchased. 
USES FOR SEA WATER AND SEA AIR APPLICATIONS 
• 30-second engine flushes

• Boat, trailer, brake wash 
• Sail boat salt removal; sails, sail covers, line, hardware

HOW TO APPLY 
• Use pressure washer 
• Connect Salt-Away Mixing Unit handle to water hose 
• Attach male threads of Mixing Unit to hose inlet connection on back side of pressure washer 
• Mixing Unit automatically dilutes product at correct ratio prior to flowing through pressure washer 
• No pre-mixing required 
• Includes a faucet which can be threaded into the cap of the container for dispensing. The recessed plug in the cap needs to be punched out before threading the faucet into place. The faucet is shown in the photo to the left, while the photo on the right shows the faucet attached to the cap. 
• The faucet is not required for dispensing. Salt-Away may be poured directly from the capped opening.
